description.value: The study examined regional brain responses to cocaine versus neutral cues in cocaine-dependent individuals and their relationships with craving and addiction severity.

spans.text: Here, in 23 cocaine-dependent individuals (CD) exposed to cocaine vs neutral cues during functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), we examined regional responses using established routines.

description.value: The 10-item brief Cocaine Craving Questionnaire was administered every 2 to 3 days during the 2- to 3-week inpatient stay and on the scan day. Items were rated from 1 to 7, with total scores from 10 to 70; averaged scores indexed tonic craving and scan-day scores indexed current craving.
